The '''Xerthian hound-slug''' was a creature from a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Xerthia system/Legends|Xerthia system]]. It was known to leave a trail of cold goo on its path.<ref name="som">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' </ref>
